mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the prior 3 months, measured as a positive change from the 3-month prior value, signals improved consumer confidence and construction sector growth that compresses equity risk premiums, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of the 3-month periods with a positive change in HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.5% per annum signals active monetary tightening that increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuation multiples, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of the periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and CPI by at least 0.05% in the prior month signal inflationary monetary tightening that raises real interest rates and reduces equity multiples, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rise > 0.05% and CPIAUCSL rise > 0.05% in prior 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of the instances where FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both rose by at least 0.05% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 7.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate by at least 0.1% over the prior month signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of the periods when UNRATE fell by at least 0.1% in a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 7.0%).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 98.0 (relative to 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of the periods when INDPRO is below 98.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the prior 6 months, measured as a positive change from the 6-month prior value, signals strong economic expansion that supports corporate profit growth and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 50% of the 6-month GDP growth periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in payrolls (PAYEMS) and housing starts (HOUST) by at least 0.5% in the prior month signal robust consumer demand and labor market strength that accelerates economic growth and equity market performance, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rise > 0.5% and HOUST rise > 0.5% in prior 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of the instances where both PAYEMS and HOUST rose by at least 0.5% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI growth exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation that prompts aggressive monetary tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity multiples, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of the periods when CPIAUCSL year-over-year growth exceeds 2.5%.
